wholeBeforeCard.front: Alkane, Alkene, Alkine: Bindung und allgemeine Formel?
wholeBeforeCard.back:
Acyclisch:

Alkane: Einfachbindungen, $C_nH_{2n+2}$

Alkene: mindestens eine Doppelbindung, $C_nH_{2n}$

Alkine: mindestens eine Dreifachbindung, $C_nH_{2n-2}$
wholeBeforeCard.category: Chemie Q1 - Organische Stoffklassen und Stereochemie

wholeCandidateCard.front: Alkane, Alkene, Alkine: Bindung und allgemeine Formel?
wholeCandidateCard.back:
Acyclische Kohlenwasserstoffe:

Alkane: nur Einfachbindungen, $C_nH_{2n+2}$

Alkene: genau eine Doppelbindung, sonst Einfachbindungen, $C_nH_{2n}$

Alkine: genau eine Dreifachbindung, sonst Einfachbindungen, $C_nH_{2n-2}$

Die Formeln gelten nicht für Ringe oder mehrere Mehrfachbindungen.

specificFindingResolved: The previous at-least-one wording allowed multiple double/triple bonds while assigning mono-unsaturated homologous formulas. Candidate exactly-one and otherwise-single wording restricts these rules to the intended neutral acyclic hydrocarbon series.

independentActualChecks.alkane: Acyclic hydrocarbon with all single carbon bonds has CnH2n+2; branched chains are included.
independentActualChecks.monoalkene: Exactly one carbon-carbon double bond and otherwise single bonds, no ring: CnH2n.
independentActualChecks.monoalkyne: Exactly one carbon-carbon triple bond and otherwise single bonds, no ring: CnH2n-2.
independentActualChecks.finiteCounterexamples: Buta-1,3-diene CH2=CH–CH=CH2 has C4H6, not C4H8. Buta-1,3-diyne HC≡C–C≡CH has C4H2, not C4H6; these actually expose the old overly broad formula premise.
independentActualChecks.formulaLimit: The explicit exclusion concerns applying these homologous-series rules to structures with rings or additional unsaturations. It does not assert that the same gross formula can never occur in another class or that formula alone determines connectivity.
independentActualChecks.frontAndScope: The unchanged front asks binding and general formula; the new answer directly supplies those limited series, remaining appropriate to the current structural/homologous-series goal. No new learner-facing goal scope or deck/ID/tag/visibility choice is created.
